    3
  ],

    "  *",
    " **",
    "***",
    " **",
    "  *"
  ]
}

Example

  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Indentation is n minus the current width.

Complexity: O(n^2) output characters

solutions.name: half-diamond-right.py
solutions.code:
def solve(n):
    return [' '*(n-i)+'*'*i for i in list(range(1,n+1))+list(range(n-1,0,-1))]
